_comment: Seed list of employers with public job board APIs. Verified live (curl) on 2026-08-07 — each slug returned real postings via Greenhouse/Lever's public API, no auth needed. Add more anytime: for a company's careers page, check if it's hosted on job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug> or jobs.lever.co/<slug>, then add the slug below. If a slug ever 404s, fetch_jobs.py logs a warning and skips it rather than failing the whole run.
